description_en: Queries the items in a specified playlist
description_zh: 查询指定节目单下的节目单项
name: ListPlaylistItems

parameters.help_en: The ID of the playlist. You can obtain the ID from the ProgramId parameter in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848078.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 节目单ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848078.html添加节目单项，请查看AddPlaylistItems接口调用返回的参数ProgramId值
parameters.name: program_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the playlist items. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). If you specify this parameter, only the information about the specified items is returned. If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all items in the playlist is returned
parameters.help_zh:
节目单项ID列表。用英文逗号（,）隔开。
如果传该参数，则只返回指定节目单项的信息。若不传，则返回该节目单所有节目单项的信息
parameters.name: program_item_ids
